dedupe_keys.name: hec fda flood damage reduction analysis software us army corps of engineers

description: HEC-FDA, the Flood Damage Reduction Analysis program from the US Army Corps of Engineers' Hydrologic Engineering Center, performs integrated hydrologic engineering and economic analysis to formulate and evaluate flood risk management plans. It stores the hydrologic, hydraulic and economic data an analysis needs, provides tools to visualise data and results, computes expected annual damage and equivalent annual damage, and computes annual exceedance probability and assurance as required for National Flood Insurance Program levee certification. It implements the risk assessment procedures of Corps engineering manual EM 1110-2-1619 and supports reporting under policy ER 1105-2-101, and is used through the planning process from the base-year without-project condition to the assessment of alternatives over the project life. Coverage: any US flood risk study area. Access: free download from the HEC site with documentation, training, known issues and FAQ pages; the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: it is designed for USACE study teams and follows Corps policy, so results depend on the supplied hydraulics and inventories. It supports flood risk management appraisal and levee performance studies, and relates to the depth-damage function record in the catalogue.
